item.title: MY TURN: No vote on Ballot Measure 2 would support construction industry
item.description: Lots of Alaskans have a stake in open primaries and dark money disclosure laws. However, I would argue that construction workers have the most at stake, and for the sake of our jobs I strongly urge a “No” vote on Ballot Measure 2. What do open primaries, ranked choice, and dark money disclosure have to do with our jobs? It’s pretty simple: Open primaries and campaign transparency mean that the best candidates can run and win, defeating demagogues who promise the world but end up wrecking the state budget. Construction workers depend on fiscal stability and a pro-jobs environment. Fundamentally, good government is good for jobs.

item.title: LETTER: Republicans must unite behind governor candidate
item.description: How many times have you seen a once happy family of siblings torn to shreds by something like pride, or more commonly, money? Usually, those two go hand in hand. Once happy siblings have been permanently ripped apart over the inheritance of the family estate. Love prevailed, and those brothers and sisters who chose the correct path have benefited from making the right choices. But absolutely true to Jesus’s words, those families who have become divided against themselves have completely fallen and have not stood. I know two brothers who have refused to speak to each other for 45 years now.
